title: TIARA MOTOR COACH DIVISION: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACK ANCHORS AND SEATS (11,880 affected)
summary: FRONT AND REAR SEAT BELTS FAILED TO COMPLY WITH FMVSS 210 LOAD TEST.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (231,833 affected)
summary: UNDER CERTAIN VEHICLE OPERATIONS AND OCCUPANT USAGE CONDITIONS, THE SAFETY BELTS CAN LOCKUP OR JAM IN THE SAFETY BELT RETRACTOR.

title: Ford Motor Company: STRUCTURE:HATCHBACK SUPPORT ROD (ALSO 13640000) (1,300 affected)
summary: MANUFACTURING ERRORS BY THE SUPPLIER OF THE LIFTGATE  LATCH MECHANISM MAY CAUSE THE SECONDARY PORTION OF THE LIFTGATE LATCH NOT TO FUNCTION. IF THE LATCH IS NOT IN THE PRIMARY LATCH POSITION, THE LIFTGATE COULD OPEN WITHOUT OPERATOR ACTION.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL TANK:AUXILLARY SELECTOR AND SWITCH (350,000 affected)
summary: THE DUAL FUEL TANK SELECTOR VALVE MAY MALFUNCTION AND CAUSE AN OVERFILL CONDITION IN ONE OF THE FUEL TANKS, RESULTING IN AN OVERFLOW OF FUEL PAST THE FILLER CAP.

title: Great Dane Trailers: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM (654 affected)
summary: THE TOP WELD ON PINTLE HOOK CROSSTUBE ASSEMBLY MAY HAVE BEEN OMITTED.

title: Ford Motor Company: STRUCTURE:HOOD ASSEMBLY:LATCHES (72,000 affected)
summary: THE SECONDARY HOOD LATCH MAY NOT ENGAGE WHEN THE HOOD IS CLOSED.

title: Jaguar Cars, Ltd.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:FRONT:UNDERHOOD (700 affected)
summary: THE ENGINE HARNESS MAY COME IN CONTACT WITH THE AIR CONDITIONING EXPANSION VALVE PROTECTION PLATE, CAUSING CHAFING OF THE HARNESS.

title: Mazda North American Operations: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM SYSTEM (29,824 affected)
summary: WHEN APPLYING THE FOOT (SERVICE) BRAKE IN THE LOW VEHICLE SPEED CONDITION, THE BRAKING POWER PRODUCED MAY BE MORE THAN EXPECTED.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (11,300 affected)
summary: THE CENTER OF THE WATER SEPARATOR PANEL LOCATED IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT BETWEEN ENGINE AND FIREWALL COULD BEND IN THE EVENT SOMEONE LEANS ON IT DURING ENGINE MAINTENANCE, REPAIRS OR CHECKING OF FLUID LEVELS. A BENT PANEL COULD INTERFERE WITH THE FREE MOVEMENT OF THE ACCELERATOR LINKAGE.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: STEERING:LINKAGES:LINK:DRAG:CONNECTION (800 affected)
summary: THE STEERING LINKAGE (DRAG LINK) BETWEEN THE STEERING GEAR PITMAN ARM AND THE STEERING ARM ON THE AXLE MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY FASTENED.

title: General Motors, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LAMP LIGHT:BRAKE WARNING (18,904 affected)
summary: BRAKE INDICATOR LIGHT MAY NOT LIGHT WHEN IGNITION IS IN THE "ON" POSITION, THE PARKING BRAKE IS APPLIED, AND THE SHIFT SELECTOR IS IN THE PARK OR NEUTRAL GEAR RANGE.

title: HOLLEY: FUEL:FUEL PUMP (493 affected)
summary: THE FUEL PUMPS MAY CONTAIN A DAMAGED INTERIOR SEAL. A DAMAGED INTERIOR SEAL MAY INTRODUCE AIR INTO THE FUEL SYSTEM, CHANGING THE FUEL DENSITY.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: WHEELS (160 affected)
summary: ROAD DEBRIS MAY ENTER AN OPENING IN THE REAR SUSPENSION TRAILING ARM AND DAMAGE THE BEARING SEAL.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: WHEELS:CAP:COVER:HUB (160 affected)
summary: THE FRONT AND REAR WHEEL HUB RETAINER NUTS HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY TORQUED. THE PRELOAD ON THE BEARING FROM THE LOOSENED HUB RETAINER NUT MAY CAUSE BEARING FAILURE.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: COMMUNICATIONS:HORN ASSEMBLY (160 affected)
summary: THE HORN ACTIVATING SWITCH COMPONENTS LOCATED IN THE STEERING COLUMN CAN WEAR ABNORMALLY.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM:UNKNOWN T (160 affected)
summary: THE LOWER BALL JOINT RETAINING NUT THAT HOLDS THE LOWER BALL JOINT TO THE STEERING KNUCKLE WAS NOT TORQUED CORRECTLY.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: STEERING:GEAR:RACK AND PINION (160 affected)
summary: THE STEERING GEAR INTERMEDIATE SHAFT CLAMPS USED TO RETAIN THE INTERMEDIATE SHAFT TO THE STEERING GEAR SHAFT AND THE COLUMN SHAFT CAN BECOME LOOSE BECAUSE OF INCORRECT BOLT SIZE AND CLAMP FORCE.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: STEERING:GEAR BOX (160 affected)
summary: THE STEERING GEAR MOUNTING BRACKET BOLTS MAY BECOME LOOSE AND ALLOW THE GEAR TO MOVE OUT OF POSITION.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT SHOCK ABSORBER (160 affected)
summary: THE REAR SHOCK ABSORBER BRACKET CAUSES THE REAR SHOCK ABSORBER LOWER MOUNTING HARDWARE TO FAIL PREMATURELY.

title: MORryde International, Inc.: SUSPENSION:TANDEM AXLE:REAR (51 affected)
summary: THE LEFT OR RIGHT FRONT TAG HANGER ASSEMBLY CAN DEVELOP A METAL FATIGUE PROBLEM WHERE THE JOURNAL TUBE IS WELDED TO THE FRAME MOUNTING PLATE. CRACKS THROUGH THE FRAME MOUNTING PLATE MAY BEGIN AROUND THE JOURNAL TUBE AND PROPAGATE UP THE SUPPORTING GUSSET.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES (365 affected)
summary: THE PATIO AWNING IS INADEQUATELY ATTACHED TO MOTORHOME AND IT COULD BEGIN TO UNRAVEL FROM THE REAR CAUSING A SHEARING OF THE FRONT LOCK.  ONCE THE LOCK IS FREE, THE ENTIRE AWNING CAN BE EXPOSED TO WIND PRESSURE AND BE TORN FROM THE SIDE OF THE MOTORHOME WHILE THE VEHICLE IS IN MOTION.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME (5,900 affected)
summary: THE VEHICLE CAPACITY WEIGHT WAS INADVERTENTLY OMITTED FROM PLACARD LOCATED INSIDE THE GAS FILLER DOOR, AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 11O.

title: General Motors, LLC: STEERING:GEAR:SHAFT LOWER FLEXIBLE PINION (2,371 affected)
summary: THE INTERMEDIATE SHAFT TO STEERING RACK LOWER COUPLING PINCH BOLT MAY BE MISSING.

title: IMPORTED AUTO PARTS CO.: FUEL:LPG VAPORIZER:REGULATOR (CONVERTER) (36,400 affected)
summary: THE SECONDARY SEAT CAN SEPARATE FROM THE SECONDARY LEVER OF THE MODEL EB OR MODEL LB CONVERTERS. THIS IS CAUSED BY A MATERIAL OR A MANUFACTURING DEFECT OF THE RUBBER SEAT.

title: SHERROD VANS, INC.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (4,842 affected)
summary: SEAT BELT ANCHORAGE BAR FOR REAR SOFA FAILED TO SUSTAIN LOADS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 210.

title: General Motors, LLC: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY:HINGE AND ATTACHMENTS (41,718 affected)
summary: FRONT DOOR INTERLOCK STRIKER MAY FAIL, CAUSING DOOR FRAME COLLAPSE AND INSUFFICIENT STRENGTH FOR THE SHOULDER BELT ANCHORAGE.

title: General Motors, LLC: STRUCTURE:HOOD ASSEMBLY:LATCHES (3,212 affected)
summary: THE SECONDARY HOOD LATCH SPRING IS IMPROPERLY INSTALLED OR MISSING, LEADING TO A CONDITION WHERE THE SECONDARY HOOD LATCH DOES NOT ENGAGE THE SECONDARY STRIKER.

title: General Motors, LLC: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:MECHANICAL:LEVER SETTLING (20,765 affected)
summary: WHEN APPLIED, THE PARKING BRAKE LEVER ASSEMBLY MAY RELEASE ONE OR MORE TEETH, REDUCING THE CABLE LOAD TO THE REAR BRAKES.
